Name: Transaction Cost (Per Trade)
Description: Estimated friction per trade (Slippage + Commissions) to realistic PnL. E.g. $4 comm + $12.50 slip = 16.5

Name: Long Entry on Wick Touch
Description: Enter if low touches lower band

Name: Long Entry on Body in Zone
Description: Enter if close is at/near lower band

Name: Long Trigger (% From Lower Band)
Description: % below lower band to trigger (0 = at band)

Name: Short Entry on Wick Touch
Description: Enter if high touches upper band

Name: Short Entry on Body in Zone
Description: Enter if close is at/near upper band

Name: Short Trigger (% From Upper Band)
Description: % above upper band to trigger (0 = at band)

Name: ATR Multiplier for Trailing Stop
Description: ATR multiplier for trailing stop distance

Name: Opposite Bollinger Band Take Profit
Description: Exit when price hits opposite band
